Bash(node -e "const data = require\('./teetimes.json'\); console.log\('Total tee times:', data.teetimes.length\); const sample = data.teetimes.slice\(0, 5\); sample.forEach\(t => console.log\(\\`  \\${t.courseId} \\${t.time} - maxPlayers: \\${t.maxPlayers}\\`\)\); const withActualMax = data.teetimes.filter\(t => t.maxPlayers && t.maxPlayers < 4\); console.log\('\\\\nTee times with maxPlayers < 4:', withActualMax.length\); withActualMax.slice\(0, 3\).forEach\(t => console.log\(\\`  \\${t.courseId} - maxPlayers: \\${t.maxPlayers}\\`\)\)")

Bash(node -e "const data = require\('./teetimes.json'\); const varied = data.teetimes.filter\(t => t.maxPlayers && t.maxPlayers < 4\); console.log\('Total:', data.teetimes.length, '| With maxPlayers < 4:', varied.length\); if\(varied.length > 0\) { console.log\('Sample with low maxPlayers:'\); varied.slice\(0, 5\).forEach\(t => console.log\(\\`  \\${t.courseId} \\${t.time} - maxPlayers: \\${t.maxPlayers}\\`\)\); } else { console.log\('NO tee times with maxPlayers < 4 found'\); }")
